_doc: Phase 1 of the product-attribute layer (docs/ATTRS.md, docs/CONCEPTS.md). Read by src/catalog/attrs.js. Patterns run against normalizeText() output (src/catalog/matching.js): no niqqud, final letters folded (ך->כ, ם->מ, ן->נ, ף->פ, ץ->צ - a pattern using a final letter can never match, same rule as config/substitutes/rules.json), punctuation stripped, single spaces. Every key is a CLOSED value set; a value is only ever READ, never guessed - absence means unknown, never the negative (a reader must not treat an absent `scented` as `unscented`).
_reuse: state.reuseForm and form.reuseForm name ids inside config/substitutes/rules.json's `form` groups (docs/CONCEPTS.md §4) - src/catalog/attrs.js reads those SAME compiled regex groups via src/pricing/substituteRules.js `rules()`, it does not copy their patterns here. `flavour` is read with the existing variantSignature() and `diet` with dietSignature() (src/pricing/substituteRules.js) - no second vocabulary for either.

state._doc: Preservation / physical state. fresh|frozen|dried|canned|smoked|cooked are reused BY REFERENCE from config/substitutes/rules.json `form` (same group ids there) - see reuseForm. thawed and pickled are new, phase-1 patterns (rules.json's `form` has no such groups).

form._doc: Physical shape/cut. sliced|grated|block|ground|whole|powder|concentrate|puree|chopped are reused BY REFERENCE from config/substitutes/rules.json `form` (same group ids there) - see reuseForm. cubes|strips|fillet are new: rules.json's own `chopped` group folds קוביות (cubes) in with קצוצ/חתוכ (chopped) for the substitute check, where the distinction does not matter; attrs phase 1 wants cubes separate, so it is read with its own pattern here rather than editing the shared substitute vocabulary.

container._doc: Packaging the product itself ships in (not the outer case/multipack).

scent._doc: Negation-first, with an explicit opposite (see `negative`): a negated `scented` publishes the literal value `unscented`, never `!scented`. Words are the general ones; the wipes-specific exclusive-group reading used by substitutes (config/substitutes/rules.json variant.groups.baby-wipes) is a separate, narrower mechanism and is not duplicated here.

code._doc: {kind, value} pairs read with a capturing regex rather than a closed word list - the value is the number/token itself. Each kind is matched and conflict-checked independently (docs/ATTRS.md): a stage disagreement never blanks a shade reading on the same product. Patterns run on normalizeText() output, which turns a hyphen into a space ('D-1000' -> 'd 1000') - every pattern below reads the separator as an OPTIONAL space, never a literal hyphen, and attrs.js re-adds a hyphen when it builds the published value. `dose` requires the word ויטמינ nearby so a vitamin's own code (D-1000, B12) is not read as an appliance `model`; `model` is the generic fallback (K300, X200) and attrs.js skips it on a name where `dose` already matched.
